correctness.rationale: Two independent exhaustive face constructions agree for all 1<=m<=7; for m=4..7 explicit full-Hasse acyclic Morse matchings give critical cell counts 1+9 (dimension 2), 1+21 (dimension 3), 1+53 (dimension 3)+1 (dimension 4), and 1+23 (dimension 3)+92 (dimension 4). Exact gradient-path signed Morse matrix is zero at m6 and has unimodular rank two at m7, with every column an integral combination of a fixed two-column basis. 2-connectivity of the reduced CW structures means degree vectors classify all 4-cell attachments. Standard cell cancellation therefore gives the asserted integral wedge types. Separately, mod-two simplicial chain computations agree. m>=8 follows from cited 2014 shellability, with symbolic count; m1..3 follow direct face counts or cited primary results.
risks: Mathematical replay relies on a finite executable certificate for four finite cases, not on a brief uniform symbolic collapse.

value.rationale: A natural first nonuniform four-row capacity family lies outside the three-row classification. The new m4,m5,m6 classifications close a meaningful gap between m3 and the literature-implied m7 and stable shellable range, especially the mixed-dimensional integral wedge at m6. These are verified exact homotopy facts, not minor algebraic rank refinements: prior bounds did not exclude lower-degree classes for these cases. Bounded-degree bipartite graph models and multigraded Segre syzygies motivate the exact capacity pattern.
risks: This is one specific capacity family, not a solution to arbitrary four-row classification.
